title: Load a user launch agent
summary: Activate a specific launch agent so it runs automatically when you log in. This is typically used after creating or modifying a .plist configuration file for a background script.

steps.explain: Load the specified launch agent plist file into launchd. It will now run according to its schedule or when you log in.

placeholders.name: AGENT_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the launch agent plist file (without .plist extension)
